elements.label: Figure 6
elements.title: Figure 6: Gap in Tertiary Education Access Rate between Kinh/Hoa and Ethnic Minorities, 2006-2018
elements.content:
Line chart
X-axis: Years (2006, 2008, 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018)
Y-axis: Access rate (%)
Legend: Kinh & Hoa (grey dashed line), Ethnic Minority (orange dashed line)

Data points:
- 2006 / Kinh & Hoa: 18
- 2006 / Ethnic Minority: 5
- 2008 / Kinh & Hoa: 16
- 2008 / Ethnic Minority: 4
- 2010 / Kinh & Hoa: 29
- 2010 / Ethnic Minority: 6
- 2012 / Kinh & Hoa: 33
- 2012 / Ethnic Minority: 9
- 2014 / Kinh & Hoa: 37
- 2014 / Ethnic Minority: 8
- 2016 / Kinh & Hoa: 42
- 2016 / Ethnic Minority: 12
- 2018 / Kinh & Hoa: 45
- 2018 / Ethnic Minority: 11

Factual comparisons:
- Kinh & Hoa access rate consistently remained substantially higher than Ethnic Minority access rate across all years.
- Kinh & Hoa access rate increased from 18% in 2006 to a peak of 45% in 2018.
- Ethnic Minority access rate ranged from a low of 4% in 2008 to a high of 12% in 2016.
- The gap widened from 13 percentage points in 2006 to 34 percentage points in 2018.

Source: Authors' calculation from VHLSS (2006-2018).
